title: City
description: A city or major settlement in the game atlas.

type.description: The type of settlement (e.g., metropolis, city, settlement).

plain.description: The plane the city is on.

world.description: The world the city is in.

continent.description: The continent the city is on.

region.description: The region the city is in.

sub_region.description: The sub-region the city is in.

title.description: Formal title or epithet of the city.

description.description: Short summary or introduction to the city.

wiki.description: Brief encyclopedic summary, often from a wiki.

image.description: Path or filename of the main city image.

thumbnail.description: Path or filename of the city thumbnail.

banner.description: Path or filename of the city banner image.

map.description: Path to the interactive city map image.

children.description: IDs of sub-regions or districts within the city.

sub_location_files.description: Paths to JSON files containing sub-locations like shops, inns, etc.

bounds.description: The leaflet-style map bounds [[lat, lng], [lat, lng]].

origin.description: The coordinate origin for the city map.

unitsPerMile.description: Scale of the city map in units per mile.

bestiary.description: Markdown link or index for bestiary data.

politics.description: Markdown link or index for political data.

religion.description: Markdown link or index for religious data.

trade.description: Markdown link or index for trade data.
